Hunza Ecolodge...
leads the way for ecotourism in Southern Hungary. We offer simple & stylish accommodation that takes you back to nature from Glamping & Mini Camping to our unique, home designed & handcrafted Tree House, Gingerbread House & Boho Wagon. These are all available individually or rented as group accommodation.

Discover
Baranya – the “Tuscany of Hungary” – is a hidden gem of nature and culture.
Enjoy forest trails, lakes, thermal baths, and the vibrant city of Pécs with its UNESCO heritage, markets, and cosy bars. Explore the Danube and Dráva by boat or kayak – or simply relax at Hunza with a glass of local wine and nature all around.
Start exploring now.

Twin Tree House Hunza Ecolodge
Skip to content
Twin Tree Houses
From 120€ / night
Prices and calendar
Book Now
What’s better than one treehouse? Two! Our Hunza Twin Treehouses sleep up to 8 guests, featuring private bathrooms, outdoor kitchen, balconies, and a blend of modern comfort with artistic, eco-friendly design.
Hand-built by us and local craftsmen using natural materials like wood, straw, and clay, they offer the perfect escape to reconnect with nature in style.
Currently under construction, available from July 2026.

Skip to content
Tree House
From 75€ / night
Prices and calendar
Book Now
Perched at the top of the Hunza grounds is the beautiful Korowai Tree House which, like in the Korowai tribe of Papua New Guinea, can accommodate a whole family. Wake up to a stunning sunrise over the valley and enjoy the balcony views as you nestle in the treetops. Relax and rejuvenate amongst peaceful, natural surroundings.

Mini Camping Hunza Ecolodge
Skip to content
Mini Camping
From 10€ / night
Prices and calendar
Book Now
If you would rather bring your own tent, why not choose a shady camping spot at the edge of Hunza’s own woodland? With a small number of separate pitches scattered throughout the property, you will be assured privacy, tranquillity and the perfect chance to reconnect with nature. We provide you with all the facilities, including the fully equipped Summer Kitchen, you need for an unforgettable stay.
